answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to submit a fresh walnut shell stained violet and bearing a vine scratch each epoch. A registrar photographs the random pattern, hashes it, destroys the shell, and rejects any duplicate hash, granting one active account per unique shell. Extra identities need extra shells at cost C per epoch; with reward R per epoch, n sybils earn n(R-C), so cloning pays only when R>C. Assumption: the registrar's uniqueness check and destruction are honest; counterfeiting or collusion is the weakness.
